title: ASPP Benchmark Record
description: Schema for recording the results of an ASPP benchmark evaluation. Protocol: The Allie Scenario Prompting Protocol (ASPP) v1.1. Creator: Darren L. Allie, Azure & Verdant Vistas, LLC. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20596641.

test_case_id.description: Identifier of the ASPP test case used for this evaluation.

test_case_title.description: Human-readable title of the test case.

model_evaluated.description: Name or identifier of the AI model evaluated.

model_version.description: Version or snapshot identifier of the model evaluated.

evaluator.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that scored this response.

response_text.description: The full text of the AI response that was evaluated.

scores.description: Points awarded for each S.C.E.N.A.R.I.O. stage.

S.description: S — State the Desired Outcome (max 10 points)

C.description: C — Clarify the Scenario Context (max 10 points)

E.description: E — Examine Constraints and Risks (max 15 points)

N.description: N — Narrow the Decision Space (max 15 points)

A.description: A — Analyze with Logic, Reasoning, Coding, or Calculation (max 20 points)

R.description: R — Recommend the Best Single Output (max 10 points)

I.description: I — Indicate Additional Outcomes Only When Necessary (max 5 points)

O.description: O — Output an Executable Action Plan (max 15 points)

total_score.description: Sum of all stage scores. Maximum is 100.

performance_level.description: Performance level derived from total score.

automatic_failure.description: True if an automatic failure condition was triggered.

automatic_failure_reason.description: Description of the automatic failure condition, if triggered.
